name: Rollins, Inc.
moat_justification: Orkin brand, route density and recurring contracts drive ROIC of 29-41% over the last five fiscal years and a stable ~52-53% gross margin, but residential switching costs are low, the industry stays fragmented, and labor costs pressure margins.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
one_liner: Elite pest-control compounder, moat 7/10 — does not clear 15% at $33.45 (weighted IRR 8.1%, IV@15% $13.91); clears 15% only below ~$13.91.
moat_for: ROIC proxy 29-41% across FY2021-25, well above cost of capital through the cycle
Orkin brand awareness lowers customer-acquisition cost vs 20,000+ local rivals
Local route density spreads fixed costs and supports industry-leading margins
Recurring contracted revenue with proven pricing power (annual price increases accepted)
Fragmented industry gives a long tuck-in acquisition runway (e.g. Saela)
moat_against: Low residential switching costs; service is replicable by local operators
Rentokil/Terminix is larger globally and integrating its US network
Labor, medical and fuel costs pressured gross margin -100bp in Q2 2026
AI-mediated search is raising residential customer-acquisition cost
Termite damage litigation is a recurring tail risk
